CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Disposition__r.Asking_Price__c), Disposition__r.Asking_Price__c <= 0, ISBLANK(BOV_Amount__c) ), null, (50 * MIN(BOV_Amount__c / Disposition__r.Asking_Price__c, 1.10) / 1.10) + IF(ISBLANK(Commission_Rate__c), 0, 25 * (3 - MAX(1, MIN(3, Commission_Rate__c * 100))) / 2) + IF(ISBLANK(Days_To_Market__c), 0, 25 * (60 - MAX(15, MIN(60, Days_To_Market__c))) / 45) )
CustomField.label: BOV Score
